proof_summary: The candidates follow from \(\varphi(F_{33})=2^{2^{33}}\) when \(F_{33}\) is prime and \(\varphi(2^{2^{33}+1})=2^{2^{33}}\), while elementary totient bounds exclude smaller candidates in the prime case and smaller even candidates in the composite case. For a smaller odd candidate, decomposing its totient over its prime divisors forces every divisor to be a Fermat prime; compositeness of \(F_{33}\) then limits the total possible 2-adic contribution to \(\sum_{j=0}^{32}2^j=2^{33}-1\), contradicting the required contribution \(2^{33}\).
